destination: General English-language report / Markdown; 180 mm wide. Target journal unspecified.
source_changes: The active N=2 M2+M3 and N=3 M1+M2+M3 records were added; the active N=4 source row uses PS01_M3DROP_A_R1; the previous N=4 backup and diagnostic rawdata archive are no longer retained.
accessibility: Okabe-Ito-derived colors plus marker shapes, text labels, hatching or separate panels. Not a compliance certification.
exports: 300 dpi opaque PNG; TrueType-embedded PDF; SVG with editable (unembedded) text.

figures.title: Current and power scaling
figures.alt_text: Current and output power rise across N=1-4; the N=2 point aggregates M0+M1 and M2+M3, the N=3 point aggregates M0+M1+M2 and M1+M2+M3, and the N=4 point uses the new record. Dashed lines to N=8 are unvalidated extrapolations.

semantics.uncertainty: N=1 current: sample SD across four distinct module references, not repeatability or CI. N=2-4: no same-combination repeat uncertainty available; N=2 and N=3 aggregate different module combinations.
semantics.model: Solid least-squares fit at N=1-4; dashed extrapolation N=4-8.

figures.title: Voltage margin
figures.alt_text: Full 3.135-3.465 V design band shown. Source mean is 3.278 V at N=4; the lowest module minimum is 3.259 V, 124 mV above the lower limit.

semantics.scale: Linear voltage axis; full +/-5% design band shown.
semantics.uncertainty: Minimum and mean are recorded window statistics, not CIs.

figures.title: Source-to-module voltage drop
figures.alt_text: Annotated 4 by 4 voltage-drop matrix. The colour scale spans the measured range of 10-18 mV; grey dash cells are modules absent from the run, not zeros.

semantics.normalization: Sequential white-to-teal scale from the measured minimum 10 mV to maximum 18 mV, linear.
semantics.missing: Absent module-count combinations are explicitly masked; no interpolation.
semantics.aggregation: Mean across available records per module and N; currently one each.

figures.title: Per-branch average current
figures.alt_text: Four same-scale dot panels compare branch means. Module 2 has 8.988 mA in its single-module reference; the N=4 Module 1 branch mean is 8.189 mA. Absent modules are labelled not in run.

semantics.encoding: Dots with exact values; color and marker shape identify physical modules.
semantics.scale: Identical focused x-axis in all panels; not a bar chart.
semantics.uncertainty: Not estimated from one run; no fabricated error bars.

figures.title: Recorded temperatures
figures.alt_text: Three same-scale point panels show recorded STM32, regulator and USB-powered Teensy temperatures. Duration is missing; no thermal scaling trend is asserted.

semantics.aggregation: Unchanged thermal_summary.csv: N=1 max STM32 and mean regulator/Teensy.
semantics.limitation: Durations missing and historical field conflict unresolved; no fit or connecting trend line.
semantics.scale: Shared linear 20-52 degC range in all three panels.

figures.title: Average versus separately captured maxima
figures.alt_text: Zero-baseline grouped bars show 32.492 mA mean and 64.22 mA sum of separately captured branch maxima at N=4. The latter is not a synchronized peak measurement.

semantics.baseline: Both bar series start at zero.
semantics.estimator: Unchanged I_peak_upper_est_mA; N=1 mean of four independent maximum readings.
semantics.limitation: Non-synchronous recorded maxima do not establish a bound on unrecorded transients.

figures.title: Single-module screening
figures.alt_text: Two panels show unchanged Module 0 and Module 1 recorded average currents and module voltages across 100 Hz ZERO, 200 Hz ZERO and 200 Hz MAX.

semantics.scale: Explicit focused linear y-ranges; no offset notation, no bar-length encoding.
semantics.data: Original three recorded conditions for Module0 and Module1; no smoothing or invented repeats.
